recipeInstructions.name: Mix and rest
recipeInstructions.text: Mix the regular flour, wholemeal flour, water, and sourdough starter. Leave for 20 minutes.

recipeInstructions.name: Stretch and fold
recipeInstructions.text: Stretch and fold every 30 minutes during the first 2 hours.

recipeInstructions.name: Bake
recipeInstructions.text: Bake at 250°C for 20 minutes, then at 220°C for another 20 minutes or until the internal temperature is 95°C.
